description: Build the expandable market accordion container component
steps: Create MarketAccordion component in web/src/components/event/market-accordion.tsx
Accept markets array with outcomes, tokenIds, and metadata
Manage expanded state (which market is currently open)
Support 'single' mode (only one market open) and 'multiple' mode
Add smooth height animation on expand/collapse using Radix Accordion
Handle keyboard navigation (arrow keys, enter, space)
Persist expanded market ID in URL hash for deep linking

description: Build the market row header with summary info
steps: Create MarketAccordionHeader component for collapsed row display
Display market name/candidate name prominently (e.g., 'Kevin Warsh')
Show current probability as large percentage with color coding
Display bid/ask spread inline (e.g., '95.4c / 4.7c')
Show 24h volume and price change indicators
Add chevron icon that rotates on expand (ChevronDown from lucide)
Include small profile image/avatar for candidate markets
Highlight selected/hovered state with subtle background change

description: Build the expandable content panel with tabs
steps: Create MarketAccordionContent component for expanded view
Implement tabbed interface with three tabs: Order Book, Graph, Resolution
Use URL hash or local state for active tab persistence within accordion
Add smooth fade-in animation when content appears
Lazy load tab content to avoid fetching data for collapsed markets
Show loading skeleton while tab content is fetching

description: Integrate existing OrderBook component into accordion tab
steps: Create OrderBookTab wrapper component
Pass tokenId from expanded market to useOrderbook hook
Display OrderBook component with proper sizing for accordion context
Show OrderBookSkeleton while data is loading
Handle orderbook unavailable gracefully (show message, not error)
Add refresh button for manual orderbook update

description: Integrate existing PriceChart component into accordion tab
steps: Create GraphTab wrapper component
Pass tokenId from expanded market to useTimeseries hook
Include TimeRangeSelector for 1H/6H/1D/1W/1M/ALL options
Display PriceChart component with responsive height for accordion
Show ChartLoadingSkeleton while data is loading
Default to 1D range for initial view
Sync time range across all markets or keep independent (configurable)

description: Integrate existing ResolutionRules component into accordion tab
steps: Create ResolutionTab wrapper component
Display market-specific resolution criteria
Show resolution source and resolver information
Parse and render markdown description with proper formatting
Add collapsible section for long resolution rules
Include end date and resolution deadline prominently

description: Handle multi-market events like 'Who will win?' with many outcomes
steps: Support events with 10+ markets (like Fed Chair nominees)
Add 'Show all X markets' expandable section for long lists
Display top N markets by volume/probability, collapse rest
Add search/filter input for finding specific markets
Sort markets by: probability (default), volume, alphabetical
Show 'X more markets' indicator when collapsed

description: Add inline Buy Yes/No buttons to accordion header
steps: Add 'Buy Yes' and 'Buy No' buttons to right side of accordion header
Style as compact pill buttons (green for Yes, red for No)
Show current price on each button (e.g., 'Yes 95c')
Clicking opens trading panel with that outcome pre-selected
Stop event propagation so clicking buy doesn't toggle accordion
Add hover tooltip showing 'Buy 100 shares for $X'
Disable buttons if market is resolved or trading is paused

description: Handle loading and error states for accordion
steps: Create MarketAccordionSkeleton for initial page load
Show skeleton rows with animated placeholders
Handle partial loading (some markets loaded, others pending)
Show error state for markets that fail to load
Add retry button for failed market data fetches
Maintain accordion structure during loading to prevent layout shift
Stack header content vertically on mobile (< 640px)
Reduce padding and font sizes for compact mobile view
Make tabs scrollable horizontally if needed on small screens
Ensure touch targets are at least 44px for accessibility
Test accordion interaction on touch devices
Consider bottom sheet pattern for tab content on mobile

description: Replace OutcomesList with MarketAccordion on event page
steps: Update web/src/app/(dashboard)/event/[slug]/page.tsx
Replace OutcomesList component with MarketAccordion
Pass full markets array with token IDs and outcomes
Wire up trading panel selection from accordion buy buttons
Ensure breadcrumbs and layout work with new component
Test with binary (Yes/No) and multi-outcome events
Verify mobile and desktop layouts work correctly

description: Add real-time price updates to accordion headers
steps: Use useMarketPrice hook to poll for price updates (10s interval)
Animate price changes with brief highlight (flash green/red)
Update probability display without full re-render
Pause polling when accordion is collapsed (optimization)
Resume polling when accordion expands
Show last update timestamp on hover
